versions.changelog:
Sensitive Word Checker v1.0.0 (敏感词筛查-CMT-1.0)

- Initial public release with built-in library of 65 sensitive words across 9 categories.
- Supports scanning PDF, Word (.docx), and Excel (.xlsx/.xls) files for sensitive/prohibited words.
- Highlights only the matched sensitive words in yellow (not full sentences/paragraphs).
- Allows use of an external custom word list (.docx) in addition to the built-in library.
- Outputs annotated files with sensitive content clearly marked.
